origin.precise_donor_difference: WSM-24 uses Euclidean hypot/sqrt nearest-neighbor distance; this research variant uses squared Euclidean and exact rationals, and is NOT the same numeric law. It does not claim executable Clojure-vs-SENS parity.

candidate.behavior: For finite nonempty ordered point clouds A,B of exact rational vectors with the same fixed dimension d>=1, compute 1/2 * (sum_a min_b sum_k(a[k]-b[k])^2 / |A| + sum_b min_a sum_k(b[k]-a[k])^2 / |B|). Return exact rational score and 0-based first-minimum (input-order) indices in both directions. Duplicates count toward each directional mean; they are not deduplicated. Reject empty clouds, mixed dimensions, non-exact coordinates. This is squared-L2 Chamfer with symmetric averaging, not WSM-24's hypot-L2 contour score.
candidate.arity: (A: nonempty finite exact rational point cloud, B: same coordinate dimension)->(score: exact rational>=0, A_to_B_indices, B_to_A_indices)
falsifiers: Keeping only the A-to-B direction breaks symmetry for unequal cardinalities.
Replacing squared Euclidean with Euclidean sqrt changes the result; WSM-24 code is a different donor variant.
Reporting 1 for A=[0,0,2] and B=[0] rather than 2/3 reveals mistaken set deduplication.
Picking the last equal-distance neighbor instead of the first breaks source-order stable witness.
Calling this a metric is false: singleton A={0},B={1},C={2} yields d(A,C)=4>d(A,B)+d(B,C)=2, violating triangle inequality.
Allowing empty point clouds, dimension mismatch or implicit float violates the exact source law.
Unrelated physical camera/astronomy/FPGA data acquisition must not claim SENS semantic authority.

minimality_attack.derivability: Finite nearest-neighbor reductions, sums and exact arithmetic likely implement this as a self-hosted library function; prove a non-derivable observable root before occupying D10 10-bit code.
